applicabilityBasis.summary: JLTXX represents Token Class shares in a registered U.S. government money-market fund under the Investment Company Act of 1940, rather than a payment-stablecoin claim. GENIUS Act Section2(22)(B)(iii) excludes securities under the 1933/1934/1940 Acts while preserving the statutory proviso for an instrument that otherwise meets the payment-stablecoin definition. This fund-share review establishes excluded-security applicability, not GENIUS authorization.
